title: Todo List
statement: Build a small todo list. Typing into the input and pressing add should append a new item to the list below. Clicking an item should mark it done, and each item needs its own delete control.

files.name: index.html
files.starterContent: todo
files.referenceContent: todo

files.name: styles.css
app.js

rubric: Adding an item appends it to the visible list without a page reload.
The input clears after adding an item.
Clicking an item visibly marks it done, e.g. with a strikethrough.
Each item has its own working delete control that removes only that item.
Pressing add with an empty input does not add a blank item.
curveballs: Actually, make the add button yellow instead of green.
Now show a count of how many items are left undone.
Move the delete control to the left side of each item instead of the right.
